title: The Night Cap | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents...“The Night Cap”, where coastal charm meets pure relaxation in Seagrove Beach! This pet-friendly retreat is made for unforgettable vacations with family, friends and your four-legged companion. Imagine mornings by your private pool, afternoons exploring Seaside with 7 included bikes and evenings unwinding in one of two separate living areas or under the covered patio. With space for 14 guests across 5 bedrooms, “The Night Cap” offers the perfect blend of comfort, flexibility and laid-back 30A living. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Pool with Covered Patio: Enjoy ultimate relaxation and privacy by your own pool, complete with a cozy covered patio for sunny afternoons or peaceful evenings.Pet-Friendly Retreat: Bring your four-legged companion along for the adventure at this welcoming Seagrove Beach home.Sleeps 14 Across 5 Bedrooms: Accommodate larger families and groups with plenty of room for everyone to relax and recharge.7 Bikes Included: Explore Seagrove Beach, Seaside and neighboring 30A communities on the included bikes.Prime Seagrove Beach Location: Discover Seaside's charming restaurants, boutiques and local favorites while enjoying everything this iconic 30A community has to offer.Two Separate Living Spaces: Enjoy the convenience of separate living areas with private entrances, ideal for multi-generational families or groups looking for added privacy.Screened Porch & Covered Patios: Spend your mornings sipping coffee or your evenings unwinding in the home's inviting outdoor spaces.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Absolutely perfect for our girls' trip! The house was a quick bike ride to Seaside which made it even better. The private pool and thoughtful layout were amazing—we couldn't have asked for more!" - Mary W.⭐ "An ideal space for two families to enjoy together! The pool was incredibly refreshing & the location near Seaside was unbeatable. We’ll definitely be back!" - Ashleigh J.⭐ "This property was spacious, beautifully designed, and in a fantastic location! Having the kids downstairs and adults upstairs worked perfectly for us. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway!" - Emily H.*** LIVING AREA ***This home is perfect for large families and groups, offering two distinct living areas designed for comfort and flexibility. The main living space on the second floor provides an inviting place to gather for movie nights or relaxed evenings, while the first-floor studio-style living area offers a separate entrance and additional privacy for guests who want their own space.Gather in the expansive second-floor living room, offering plenty of space for everyone to relax and spend time together.Settle into comfortable lounge seating and enjoy your favorite shows or a movie night on the flat-screen TV.Take advantage of the separate first-floor studio-style living space, complete with its own private entrance for added convenience and privacy.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***With two fully equipped kitchens, “The Night Cap” makes hosting larger groups easy. Prepare meals together upstairs or take advantage of the separate first-floor kitchen for added convenience throughout your stay.Prepare delicious meals in either of the home's two fully equipped kitchens, both featuring stainless steel appliances.Enjoy the convenience of a standalone ice maker in the second-floor kitchen, along with island seating for 4.Gather around the first-floor dining table with seating for 4, plus additional bar seating for 3.Take your meals outdoors and enjoy the second-floor patio dining area with seating for 5.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Designed with larger families and groups in mind, the sleeping arrangements are spread across three levels and offer plenty of flexibility for everyone to settle in comfortably.1st Floor:Queen Sleeping Area: Queen bed in an open studio-style living space with a flat-screen TV.Bunk Room: Full-over-Full bunk bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity & shower/tub combo2nd Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and spacious walk-in shower.Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and balcony access.Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen bed and flat-screen TV.Full Guest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo.3rd Floor Loft:Loft Sleeping Area: Two Twin beds and flat-screen TV.*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step outside and settle into your own private outdoor retreat surrounded by lush coastal landscaping. Spend sunny afternoons lounging by the pool, enjoy dinner fresh off the grill or relax beneath the covered patio. With multiple outdoor spaces to gather and unwind, everyone can settle into vacation mode with ease.Spend sunny afternoons lounging beside your private pool, complete with comfortable outdoor seating.Relax beneath the covered patio, offering a shaded place to gather and unwind.Fire up the grill and enjoy casual cookouts in the outdoor dining area.Hop on one of the 7 included bikes and explore the beautiful communities along Scenic Highway 30A.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach along Scenic Highway 30A, “The Night Cap” offers a wonderful home base for exploring the area's charming coastal communities. Spend the afternoon biking through Seaside, discover local restaurants and boutiques or venture out to nearby state parks and scenic trails. With so much to see and do along 30A, there's something for everyone to enjoy.Explore Seaside's charming restaurants, boutiques, food trucks and iconic town square.Enjoy biking along the Scenic 30A bike path as you discover Seagrove, Seaside and surrounding communities.Discover the scenic trails, coastal dune lakes and natural Florida beauty of Deer Lake State Park.*** PET FRIENDLY ***Two dog maximum, with a combined weight of 50 lbs. 25 lb maximum weight limit per dogNon shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogPets are not allowed in the pool at anytimeWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separatelyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThe first and second floors are not internally connected, ensuring privacy for multi-family groups*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 12220STRO #: STR-012220 Read less
